mapper.select: select A.slug, A.view_count viewCount, A.created_at articleCreatedAt, (select count(1) from article_favorites AF where AF.article_id = A.id) favoritesCount, (select count(1) from comments C where C.article_id = A.id) commentsCount from articles A where A.slug = #{slug}

select A.slug, A.title, count(AF.user_id) recentFavoritesCount from article_favorites AF join articles A on A.id = AF.article_id where AF.created_at >= #{since} group by A.id, A.slug, A.title order by recentFavoritesCount desc, A.slug asc limit #{limit}
